terrain_source: SRTM 1 arc-second, AWS Terrain Tiles, N26E091
rainfall_assumption: One hourly NASA POWER point value is applied uniformly over the 50x50 local grid; the hourly value is held constant during that hour.
spinup_assumption: Each event starts dry and is spun up for 6 hours using preceding hourly precipitation.
infiltration_assumption: Constant loss rates of 0, 5, and 10 mm/hour; not soil-calibrated.
manning_assumption: Uniform Manning n values of 0.03, 0.05, and 0.08; not land-cover-derived.
